page.overview:
What is Uttermost East?

The Burnt Land of the Sun, also known as the Lands of the Sun, Easterness, the Eastland, and the Eastern Land, was an empty land in the far east of Arda where the sun rose at dawn. The land was separated from Middle-earth by the waters of the Eastern Sea. Nothing is known of its geography except that there was a great, curve-shaped mountain range called the Walls of the Sun that corresponded symmetrically to the Pelóri, the Mountains of Aman in the far west.

Oromë described the East to the Valar, saying that "there is a silent beach and dark empty seas". It is also told that Aulë and Ulmo built "great havens" for the Sun and the Moon "beside the soundless sea".

The Númenóreans may have visited it on their sea journeys into the far east of Arda, in the middle of the Second Age, since in the Akallabêth of The Silmarillion it is mentioned that they saw even the Gates of Morning in the east.

The Burnt Land of the Sun may have been a part of the Empty Lands that Eru "cast back" during the Downfall of Númenor.
